goal_text: The entry is complete and honest
outcome: Everything the event requires for a submission exists in the repository and is verified by a script, not asserted: a working demo, a video walkthrough under five minutes recorded from a shot list whose claims the receipts support (one fresh branch live, any precomputed cohort labelled replay), and a repository link with setup instructions, plus the submission form text (title, one-liner, description, how Airwallex is used, testing instructions with no login for reading, links) and the upstream attribution.
